master: Output volume of the whole PYRA (all the layers).
polyphony: How many notes can sound at the same time.
voiceMode: Poly plays chords. Mono plays one note at a time. Legato slides between held notes without restarting them.
glide: Portamento: how long a note takes to slide to the next one. 0 = off.
glideLegato: Slide only when the new note is played while another one is still held.
bendUp: How far the pitch wheel bends up, in semitones.
bendDown: How far the pitch wheel bends down, in semitones.
mpe: Turns on MPE: per-note pitch, pressure and slide from MPE controllers.
mpeRange: Pitch-bend range of each note in MPE mode, in semitones.
velAmp: How much playing harder makes the sound louder.
transpose: Moves the whole sound up or down in semitones.
tune: Fine tuning of the whole synth, in cents.
drift: Slow random pitch wandering, like an old analog synth.
spread: Every note is slightly different in pitch, filter and timing.
filterRouting: Serial: filter 1 feeds filter 2. Parallel: the two filters work side by side.
macro: Macro knob: assign it in the MATRIX (or drag its badge onto knobs) to move many things at once.
osc_on: Switches this oscillator on or off.
osc_wt: The wavetable this oscillator plays, sorted in categories (Analog, Digital, Vocal...).
osc_pos: Position inside the wavetable: morphs between its frames. You can also drag up and down in the screen.
osc_pan: Left / right position of this oscillator.
osc_oct: Moves this oscillator up or down by octaves.
osc_semi: Moves this oscillator up or down by semitones.
osc_fine: Fine tuning in cents: small amounts make it thicker against the other oscillators.
osc_voices: Unison: how many copies of the oscillator play together (a wider, thicker sound).
osc_detune: How far apart the unison voices are tuned.
osc_blend: Balance between the centre voice and the detuned unison voices.
osc_width: Stereo spread of the unison voices.
osc_phase: Where the waveform starts at each note.
osc_rand: Random start for each note (0 = every attack sounds the same).
osc_warp: Warp mode: bends the waveform (sync, bend, PWM, mirror, fold...).
osc_warpAmt: Amount of the warp mode. You can also drag left and right in the screen.
osc_fmSrc: Which source modulates the pitch of this oscillator (FM).
osc_fmAmt: Amount of frequency modulation: from warmth to metallic, bell-like tones.
osc_route: Where this oscillator goes: filter 1, filter 2, both, or straight out.
sub_on: Switches the sub oscillator on or off.
sub_shape: Waveform of the sub oscillator, sorted in categories.
sub_oct: Octave of the sub oscillator (usually 1 or 2 below).
sub_pan: Left / right position of the sub oscillator.
sub_route: Where the sub goes: filter 1, filter 2, both, or straight out.
noise_on: Switches the noise generator on or off.
noise_type: Kind of noise: colours, textures (vinyl, wind, rain...) or digital.
noise_pan: Left / right position of the noise.
noise_route: Where the noise goes: filter 1, filter 2, both, or straight out.
f_on: Switches this filter on or off.
f_type: Filter type: low pass, high pass, band pass, notch, shelves, comb, formant...
f_cutoff: Cutoff frequency: where the filter starts to work. You can also drag the point in the screen.
f_res: Resonance: boosts the frequencies around the cutoff (on the shelves: boost or cut).
f_drive: Saturation before the filter: warmer and dirtier.
f_mix: Balance between the dry sound and the filtered sound.
f_key: Key tracking: higher notes open the filter more.
f_env: How much envelope 2 moves the cutoff.
env_dly: Waiting time before the envelope starts.
env_att: Attack: time to reach full level. You can also drag the points in the screen.
env_hold: Time the envelope stays at full level after the attack.
env_dec: Decay: time to fall to the sustain level.
env_sus: Sustain: level held while the key is down.
env_rel: Release: time to fade out after the key is released.
lfo_shape: LFO shape, sorted in categories. To draw your own, just draw in the screen.
lfo_rate: LFO speed in Hz (when Sync is off).
lfo_sync: Locks the LFO to the tempo of your DAW.
lfo_div: LFO speed in note values (when Sync is on).
lfo_mode: Retrig: restarts with each note. Free: keeps running. Envelope: plays once.
lfo_delay: Time before the LFO starts moving.
lfo_fade: Time for the LFO to fade in.
lfo_uni: Unipolar: the LFO only goes up from zero instead of up and down.
lfo_smooth: Smooths the corners of the LFO shape.
mod_amt: How much, and in which direction, the source moves the destination.
fx_dist_on: Switches the distortion on or off.
fx_dist_type: Kind of distortion: soft or hard clip, tube, fold, bitcrush...
fx_dist_drive: How hard the sound is pushed into the distortion.
fx_dist_mix: Balance between the clean and the distorted sound.
fx_res_on: Switches the resonator on or off.
fx_res_mix: Balance between the dry sound and the resonator.
fx_flt_on: Switches the FX filter on or off.
fx_flt_cutoff: Cutoff frequency of the FX filter.
fx_flt_mix: Balance between dry and filtered sound.
fx_cho_on: Switches the chorus on or off.
fx_cho_delay: Base delay of the chorus voices.
fx_cho_fb: Feedback: a stronger, more metallic chorus.
fx_cho_mix: Balance between dry sound and chorus.
fx_fla_on: Switches the flanger on or off.
fx_fla_mix: Balance between dry sound and flanger.
fx_pha_on: Switches the phaser on or off.
fx_pha_fb: Feedback: a stronger, more resonant phaser.
fx_pha_stages: Number of phaser stages (more = more notches).
fx_pha_mix: Balance between dry sound and phaser.
fx_tape_on: Switches the tape effect on or off.
fx_tape_wow: Slow pitch wobble, like a worn tape.
fx_tape_flutter: Fast pitch flutter of the tape.
fx_tape_mix: Balance between dry sound and tape.
fx_dly_on: Switches the delay on or off.
fx_dly_mode: Digital, tape echo, or ping-pong (bouncing left and right).
fx_dly_sync: Locks the delay time to the tempo of your DAW.
fx_dly_div: Delay time in note values (when Sync is on).
fx_dly_time: Delay time in milliseconds (when Sync is off).
fx_dly_lowcut: Removes low frequencies from the repeats.
fx_dly_highcut: Removes high frequencies from the repeats.
fx_dly_mix: Balance between dry sound and echoes.
fx_rev_on: Switches the reverb on or off.
fx_rev_type: Room, hall, or shimmer (with octaves up).
fx_rev_decay: How long the reverb tail lasts.
fx_rev_mix: Balance between dry sound and reverb.
fx_eq_on: Switches the EQ on or off.
fx_eq_lowg: Boost or cut of the low band.
fx_eq_midg: Boost or cut of the middle band.
fx_eq_midq: Width of the middle band (higher = narrower).
fx_eq_highg: Boost or cut of the high band.
fx_comp_on: Switches the compressor on or off.
fx_comp_thresh: Level above which the compressor starts working.
fx_comp_ratio: How strongly the loud parts are turned down.
fx_comp_rel: How fast the compressor lets go.
fx_comp_makeup: Volume added back after the compression.
fx_comp_mix: Balance between dry and compressed sound (parallel compression).
an_age: Turns a clean digital synth into a worn analog one (drift, spread, saturation, noise).
an_tolerance: Oscillators and filters never perfectly matched, like real components.
an_circuit: Warm, slightly uneven saturation of the voice circuit.
an_bits: Lower bit depth, like old samplers.
an_rate: Lower sample rate, like old samplers (aliasing).
arp_on: Switches the arpeggiator on or off (it plays all the layers).
arp_mode: Order of the notes: up, down, random, as played, or the step sequencer.
arp_oct: How many octaves the arpeggio covers.
arp_swing: Delays every second step for a shuffle feel.
arp_latch: Keeps playing after you release the keys.
arp_scale: Scale used by the NOTE steps.
arp_velamt: How much the step velocities change the volume.
chaos_amt: Random movement: up to half it keeps the sound alive, towards the top it tears it apart.
chaos_bite: How sharp the chaos jumps are.
chaos_space: How much the chaos moves the sound in the stereo space and in the effects.
chaos_seed: A different random pattern for the chaos.
focus_amt: One knob that moves up to 8 chosen targets at once.
focus_curve: How the movement grows along the knob (gentle start or fast start).
motion_amt: Rhythmic movement locked to the tempo of your DAW.
motion_shape: Kind of movement: pump, gate, sweep, wobble, auto-pan...
motion_rate: Speed of the movement in note values.
motion_smooth: Softens the edges of the movement.
smp_on: Switches the sampled instrument layer on or off.
smp_pan: Left / right position of the sample.
smp_fine: Fine tuning of the sample, in cents.
smp_start: Where the sample starts (skips part of the attack).
smp_vel: How much the velocity switches between soft and hard recordings.
smp_route: Where the sample goes: filter 1, filter 2, both, or straight out.
glide_type: Constant time: every slide lasts the same. Constant rate: bigger jumps take longer.
chaos_mangle: How wild CHAOS gets near the top: glitches, grains, reverses.
fx_glt_on: Switches the glitch effect on or off.
fx_glt_steps: Number of steps in the glitch pattern.
fx_glt_smooth: Smooths the edges between the glitch steps.
fx_glt_mix: Balance between the clean sound and the glitches.
fx_grn_on: Switches the granular effect on or off.
fx_grn_density: How many grains play at once.
fx_grn_spray: How far back in time the grains are taken from.
fx_grn_pitch: Pitch of the grains, in semitones.
fx_grn_freeze: Freezes the sound into an endless cloud.
fx_grn_mix: Balance between dry sound and grains.
fx_shf_on: Switches the frequency shifter on or off.
fx_shf_freq: How many Hz the sound is shifted (metallic, inharmonic).
fx_shf_fb: Feedback: endless rising or falling spirals.
fx_shf_width: Opposite shift on the left and on the right.
fx_shf_mix: Balance between dry and shifted sound.
chord_on: Switches the chord generator on or off (it plays all the layers).
chord_mode: Progression: holding a key plays the chords in time. Chord per key: each key plays its own chord.
chord_trigger: Hold key, latch, or play whenever your DAW plays.
chord_scale: Scale the chords are built from.
chord_count: How many chords are in the progression.
chord_size: Triads, sevenths, ninths, sus, power chords, or a mix.
chord_voicing: How the notes are spread: close together or wide apart.
chord_inv: Inversion: Smooth picks the one closest to the chord before.
chord_rhythm: How the chords are played: held, pulsing, offbeats...
chord_oct: Moves the chords up or down by octaves.
chord_bass: Adds the root note one octave below.
chord_strum: Plays the notes one after another, like a guitar strum.
chord_human: Small random changes in timing and velocity, like a real player.
chord_complex: For RANDOM: simple progressions or richer chords.
chord_mood: Emotion for RANDOM: progression, scale, rhythm and voicing follow the mood.
layer_link: Moving a knob moves the same knob on every layer that is on.
layer_on: Switches this layer on or off.
layer_pan: Left / right position of this layer.
layer_chan: MIDI channel this layer listens to.
